findings.summary: Loading state is a bespoke single-line card with plain text instead of the shared LoadingScreen primitive or the app's animate-pulse skeleton pattern used on other pages.
findings.fix:
Replace the inline `
جارٍ تحميل ملف الموظف…
` with a skeleton matching the app convention (e.g. `
` as in OperationsCenterPage/AuditSecurityPage) or the `LoadingScreen` primitive.

findings.summary: The back link reimplements a secondary button with ad-hoc utility classes (rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] px-4 py-2.5) instead of the design-system `.btn-secondary` class.
findings.fix: Use `<Link to="/hr/employees" className="btn-secondary"><ArrowRight className="size-4" />عودة للموظفين</Link>` so the back action matches the standard secondary-button styling, focus/hover states, and dark-theme tokens.

findings.summary: The employee photo uses empty alt="" even though it conveys identity, so screen-reader users get no name association for the avatar image.
findings.fix: Set `alt={item.fullNameAr}` on the `` so the photo is announced with the employee's name instead of being treated as purely decorative.

findings.summary: The asset row is represented only by a BriefcaseBusiness icon with no text/aria-label, so screen readers get no indication of the asset's held/unreturned status (icon-only, meaning conveyed by icon alone).
findings.fix: Add an accessible label to the icon, e.g. `<BriefcaseBusiness className="size-5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" aria-label="عهدة قيد الاستلام" />` (or add a small StatusBadge/text), so the asset's status is not conveyed by the icon alone.

findings.summary: The icon uses className="size-5 muted" applying the `.muted` text-color helper to an SVG with non-standard class ordering, inconsistent with the app's icon coloring convention (`text-[var(--text-muted)]` or `muted` prefixed).
findings.fix: Change to `className="size-5 text-[var(--text-muted)]"` to color the icon via the token directly and match how icons are muted elsewhere.

findings.summary:
The empty documents/requests/tasks sub-sections use a bare `

` line rather than a consistent inline empty treatment, and the documents empty message ignores the assets list that may still render below.
findings.fix: Standardize the inline empty message styling across the three panels (lines 79, 98, 107) using the same centered muted-text pattern, and word line 79 as documents-specific since assets can still appear beneath it.

findings.summary: The 'العلاقة الإدارية' side panel is a bespoke rounded box built from raw utilities while the metrics above use MetricCard, giving inconsistent card treatment for summary-style info within the same header.
findings.fix: Wrap the managerial-relations panel in the standard `.card`/`.metric-card` surface (or keep bg-[var(--surface-muted)] but align radius/padding with the Data tiles) so surface styling is consistent across the header block.

findings.summary: Section vertical rhythm is inconsistent: the outer stack uses space-y-6 while inner grids alternate between gap-4 (line 56) and gap-5 (lines 63, 94), producing uneven spacing between comparable sections.
findings.fix: Pick one gap scale for the equivalent section grids (e.g. gap-5 for all three `<section className="grid ...">` blocks, or align all to space-y-6 rhythm) so inter-card spacing is uniform.
